item.description:
VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.116

  • Fixes Pair Phone QR regeneration so setup payloads are restored from the installed bridge config during status checks.
  • Makes Powerhouse warm/install runs nonblocking from the Companion UI, with status polling instead of a blind long-running request.
  • Keeps route startup independent from Powerhouse prewarm completion.

VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.115

  • Improves OpenAI OAuth handoff between the iPhone app, Companion QR sync, and Companion Realtime Voice.
  • Keeps OpenAI STT and OpenAI Companion Realtime Voice LLMs OAuth-first, using API-key fallback only when the paired iPhone explicitly enables it.
  • Refreshes and persists Companion-side ChatGPT OAuth into the bridge configuration so the runtime can recover from stale imported credentials.
  • Preserves OpenAI TTS and GPT-Realtime-2 API-key behavior where those paths currently require it.

VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.114

  • Adds GPT-5.4 as a Companion Realtime Voice LLM option and keeps GPT-5.4-mini selectable.
  • Maps legacy GPT-5.4-nano selections to GPT-5.4-mini instead of advertising nano as a live option.
  • Adds forward-compatible GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna route vocabulary so the Companion does not coerce those preview routes back to GPT-5.5.
  • Keeps the HF speech-to-speech runtime readiness and 16 kHz runtime contract intact.
